title: ARTICLE by number: current_article_number updated even when lookup will fail
description: In lifecycle.rs lookup_article_content_by_number() (line 1110), ctx.current_article_number is set to 'number' before returning Ok(content). But the IPFS fetch on line 1088 can fail and return Err — in that error path current_article_number is NOT updated, which is correct. However, the 423 path (article_numbers lookup returns None, line 1082) also does NOT update current_article_number, which is also correct. But line 1110 happens only after all the fallible operations, so this is fine. Recheck: the number assignment at 1110 is inside Ok(...) so it only runs on success. This is correct — false alarm. Filed to document the analysis.
